correctness.rationale: For fixed u=x+y and v=x+z, the combined objective is affine in x, so only x=0 and x=min(u,v) need be checked. The x=0 branch has unique minimum 2(1-B) at u=v=1. The other endpoint is bounded below by -B^2/4 or 1-B, both strictly above 2(1-B) when 4-2*sqrt(2)<B<2. At the all-shortcut flow, every path costs B, and the combined equilibrium cost is 3B. Therefore the unique optimum costs B+2 and the exact ratio is 3B/(B+2).
